evenements.description: Je Vais Prendre Mon Temps is a Zee Stacks Production built around tension, slow burn, dark femininity, desire and rage. Twiggy produces, curates and hosts. The billed company includes Mademoiselle George, Delulu Darling, Aizysse Baga, Lia Jasmine, Baby Hector, Twiggy and Velour, along with @esirenaa, @heshibaa and @wish.borne. Doors open at 19:00 and curtains are at 20:00. Tickets are available online.
